name: Pelham Claw-Guard Wide Runner
description: A running shoe with a dramatically widened toe box — almost twice standard width — and reinforced toe cap channels that create individual lanes for clawed toes without restricting them. The upper is a breathable mesh-synthetic blend with a structured midfoot. It looks like a chunky athletic shoe from the heel, normal from the side, and distinctly wide and blunt at the front. Tier 2-3 geneware users who want to actually exercise with claw-foot mods without destroying standard footwear inside a month.
functionality: Wide-last construction with individual claw-channel toe cap. Reinforced upper resists tearing from claw protrusion under lateral stress.
what_it_says: You're active, you're practical, and you got the geneware for function not aesthetics — or both.
worn_by: geneware users who need athletic footwear
story_hooks: Pelham is the only athletic brand making claw-compatible runners at this price point — a corponation buyout offer is on the table and the community is watching.
A pair was found with the claw channels deliberately reinforced with a filed-down blade — someone was using them as a weapon.

physical_description.visual_profile: A chunky athletic runner with a dramatically flared toe box that transitions from conventional heel profile to a blunt, almost squared-off forefoot. The silhouette reads as aggressive and purposeful—built for non-standard anatomy. From the side it appears like any premium running shoe; head-on it's visibly wider and more imposing.
physical_description.fit: Compression midfoot with structured arch support; toe box is aggressively roomy with individual channeled lanes rather than a unified toe cavity. Heel cup is snug, forefoot is expansive without being sloppy.
physical_description.primary_material: Breathable mesh-synthetic blend upper with ballistic-weave reinforcement panels; molded TPU toe cap with internal channel ribbing; cushioned EVA midsole with integrated flex grooves
physical_description.texture: Mesh surface is smooth yet textured for grip; toe cap has subtle quilted channeling visible through translucent material; midsole shows engineered tread pattern with angular lugs
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal base with neon-cyan accent stitching along the toe channels and heel tab. Reflective piping at the ankle collar. Optional two-tone: metallic silver on the structural midfoot cage.
physical_description.closures: Asymmetrical lacing system with magnetic microclips at the midfoot; friction-lock heel counter; optional velcro toe-box tensioner for dial-fit adjustment
distinctive_features: Five individual toe channels with reinforced sidewalls
Claw-optimized toe cap with hardened impact zones
Midfoot exoskeleton cage for lateral stability
Breathable gusset venting at the toe box sides
Pelham Athletic logo embossed on the heel counter
Optional augmentation-grade material cert stamp on the tongue
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3: Premium functional—expensive enough to signal disposable income, practical enough for working professionals with mods
physical_description.cultural_context: Geneware athlete or active corporate augmentation user. Worn by people who treat their body modifications as performance upgrades rather than cosmetic statements. Signals investment in legitimate genetic modification with professional-grade equipment support.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine to broken-in; the reinforced toe channels show predictable wear patterns from claw friction. Scuff marks on the outer toe cap from real use. Midsole creasing at the forefoot is normal and expected.
